deviations: Reference line buttons stay available on narrow screens and use one roving tab entry; per-line hidden/untabbable controls are removed.

File/language switching is authored composition; v0 coupling and inline brand artwork are removed.
Line background priority is referenced, removed, added, highlighted; all supplied flags remain available.
